Invented regulatory/batch verification code ('REV 2.4 / BATCH VERIFIED')
Premature assertion of variant-specific claims and dosage ('13X EPA bioavailability', '13X Better EPA Absorption', '1 Softgel Daily') into generic layout/structural test prompts
actionable_learnings: Strictly prohibit fabricating numerical dimensions, particle metrics, or compliance codes; use unlabelled dimension lines, blank measurement ticks, or [DIMENSION] markers

Only include approved claims verbatim when explicitly required by the brief, accompanied by mandatory footnotes
